content: GitHub Actions upload-artifact (v4) does not dereference symlinks and can mangle macOS .app bundles: users report only 'Contents' folder surviving upload, or symlinks (e.g. Versions/Current inside .framework) uploaded as broken links; zip compression inside upload-artifact also loses POSIX permissions. Fix: tar/ditto the .app into a single archive file before calling upload-artifact, then untar/unditto after download, rather than uploading the .app directory tree directly.
